findings.note: Old 2025 page: in 2024-25 Monahan had 38 assists in 54 games, played about 19 minutes a night and led the NHL in 5-on-5 assists per 60. Nothing current was found to show he still has that role, and the +310 price may mean his role is smaller now.

Old January 2025 report: Columbus put Monahan on injured reserve with an upper-body injury. It shows he has been hurt before, but no current injury, practice or lineup news for Oct 18, 2026 turned up in the search.
